title: Warmly Charred Mexican Shungiku Tacos
description: A kid-friendly Mexican dish featuring charred shungiku, this recipe is nut-free and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The shungiku is broiled to bring out its natural sweetness and paired with crispy tacos.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the shungiku and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, toss the shungiku with olive oil, lime juice, salt, and pepper until it is evenly coated.
Spread the shungiku on a baking sheet and broil for 5 minutes, or until it is charred and slightly wilted.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat and saute the diced onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Warm the taco shells according to the package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the charred shungiku, sauteed onion and garlic, and shredded cheese into the taco shells.
Top each taco with a dollop of sour cream and serve immediately.
